value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Existence(has_key) clause (R1) is redundant because it is already implied by the hard Existence(door_open) together with the hard Precedence(has_key, door_open). Remove this clause while keeping the other clauses unchanged.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard clause "Eventually the agent has the key" (Existence(has_key)) is redundant because the hard Existence(door_open) together with the hard Precedence(has_key, door_open) already forces the key to be acquired before the door opens. Remove this clause and keep the other three clauses (hard Existence(door_open), soft Existence(at_goal), hard Precedence(has_key, door_open), hard Precedence(door_open, at_goal)).

CHANGES REQUIRED: The task commands the agent to pick up the key, but no clause makes that happen. Add a hard Existence(has_key) clause. With this clause, the hard Precedence(has_key, door_open) and hard Precedence(door_open, at_goal) correctly enforce the order, and the soft Existence(at_goal) captures the optional goal of reaching the goal.
